hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Polished rod and clamp
function: The smooth rod at the top of the rod string that reciprocates through the stuffing box, clamped to the carrier bar.

tabs.overview: Hardened, polished surface for the packing; the clamp sets the spacing of the pump.
tabs.safety: Clamp torque and rod wear inspected.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
